text: Hypocrisy is an homage that vice pays to virtue.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
visual_brief: A precise architectural elevation and section of an ornate classical facade standing entirely freestanding, held upright from behind by stark utilitarian timber scaffolding and diagonal bracing. Orthographic style with delicate drafting lines, masonry hatch patterns, and engineering dimension callouts.
alt: Architectural drawing of an ornate classical facade supported by rear wooden scaffolding.
